evidence.quote: the Committee decided to continue purchasing additional agency mortgage-backed securities at a pace of $40 billion per month and longer-term Treasury securities at a pace of $45 billion per month
The Committee sees the downside risks to the outlook for the economy and the labor market as having diminished since the fall.
Partly reflecting transitory influences, inflation has been running below the Committee's longer-run objective, but longer-term inflation expectations have remained stable.
the Committee expects that a highly accommodative stance of monetary policy will remain appropriate for a considerable time after the asset purchase program ends and the economic recovery strengthens
Labor market conditions have shown further improvement in recent months, on balance, but the unemployment rate remains elevated.

parsed.rationale: The statement continues $85 billion in monthly purchases and keeps the extended low-rate guidance, with inflation running below target, so the net signal is accommodative.
